map.输入：6 个牙位 GI 评分 [0,1,1,2,1,0]\n计算：GI 均值 =:
Input: 6 tooth-site GI scores [0,1,1,2,1,0]

Note: higher score means more severe inflammation; judge with BOP-positive rate.
map.牙龈指数(GI)怎么分？: How is the Gingival Index (GI) graded?
